purpose: Fail closed if a raw native-4K temporal frame changes camera, render-target, physical-lighting, renderable-scene, material, GI, reflection-probe or render-policy state between Camera.onPreCull, Camera.onPreRender and Camera.onPostRender. This contract is evidence-integrity infrastructure only and awards zero Visual Fidelity points.
failureInjection: Change MainCamera position, rotation, FOV, clip planes, culling mask or viewport between pre-cull and pre-render and require the frame to fail.
Change the raw temporal RenderTexture dimensions, format, sRGB state, MSAA samples, mip state, filter or wrap mode during the frame and require failure.
Add a camera command buffer or a second enabled OnRenderImage effect and require failure.
Change SummerSun direction, color, intensity, shadow state, sky/ambient state or global render policy during the frame and require failure.

Change a renderable mesh, material, texture, MaterialPropertyBlock, GI/lightmap binding or reflection-probe state during the frame and require the physical-lighting fingerprint to change and the frame to fail.
Start a second raw temporal lifecycle on the same RenderTexture before the prior lifecycle completes and require failure.

formalBehavior.preCull: Read-only validation establishes the accepted camera/target and complete physical-lighting/renderable-state SHA-256 fingerprints.
formalBehavior.preRender: Read-only validation must reproduce both pre-cull fingerprints exactly before rasterization proceeds.
formalBehavior.postRender: Read-only validation must reproduce both pre-cull fingerprints exactly before readback/sealing; the lifecycle is then cleared.
